about.title: About
intro: I'm a senior front-end engineer in Boulder, Colorado, with more than 10 years of experience building accessible, interactive web experiences.

I hold a Master's degree in Emergent Digital Practices. Since then I've built marketing sites, interactive maps, data visualizations and animated quizzes for agency clients, front-end components and APIs for a SaaS product at SparkFun Electronics, and most recently interactive science simulations for students.
I build to WCAG 2.1 AA from the start, and I led an accessibility audit of a 34-product interactive learning library, prototyping fixes and delivering a roadmap for improvements.
I do my best work in close partnership with designers and content teams, bringing design thinking, a strong visual eye and a knack for troubleshooting to every project.

stem.title: Interactive STEM simulations at ExploreLearning
stem.text: Interactive science simulations for students, built in Vue 2 and TypeScript with d3.js, p5.js and Grapes.js: satellite orbits, an earthquake warning system, sound waves and permafrost protection.

sparkfun.title: SparkFun Electronics
sparkfun.text: Front-end components and APIs for À La Carte, a SaaS product that let customers design custom circuit boards by dragging and dropping components. Built with Angular, Node.js and MongoDB.

agency.title: Agency work with LGND and IMM
agency.text: Marketing sites, interactive maps, data visualizations and animated quizzes for clients including Toyota, Ending Pandemics, NRG, Greater Washington Partnership and Aireon. For Tracfone, I managed a team of 3 developers who built 32 suites of animated HTML5 banner ads in 6 weeks.

education.title: Master's degree in Emergent Digital Practices
education.text: My thesis project was the front end of a data visualization platform for Social Explorer, built with Node.js and p5.js.
